summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns Update(prologue, res) with the early empty-list return kept; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Open issue: keeping the empty-request early return as a bare list conflicts with the requirement that evaluating an empty result must not raise, since evalUpdate now reads .algebra and will raise AttributeError on []. Needs a decision.
